units: relative operator differences, RMS ratios, eta/q/gate statistics are dimensionless; response RMS uses projected feature units

definitions.operator_relative_frobenius_text_visual_: Frobenius norm of the mean of learned P_text and P_visual
definitions.operator_relative_frobenius_vs_uniform_d: Frobenius norm of the uniform normalized operator
definitions.chebyshev_correlation: Pearson correlation of flattened node-by-feature responses for each order pair
definitions.attention_increment_ratio: RMS of omega*attention_output on orders 1..K divided by RMS of raw B_k-B_0; also reports the differential increment after subtracting order-0 attention update
definitions.residual_ratio_distribution: per-node RMS(g*U) divided by per-node RMS(H0), with empirical quantiles
definitions.eta_node_std: population standard deviation across nodes separately for each order and modality
